# WellaWhite Water Flosser

WellaWhite Water Flosser is a rechargeable water-jet dental hygiene device with three cleaning modes, interchangeable nozzles, a large water tank and a long-lasting battery.

## Product information
The site covers targeted water-jet cleaning, three cleaning modes, sensitive-gum use, cleaning around braces and dental appliances, rechargeable battery use, daily operation, maintenance and product FAQ.
